subject: prd/installer
statement: If the GitHub credential lacks a permission (e.g. admin for protection), or a transient API failure (rate limit, server error) interrupts wiring, then the system shall complete every permitted step, retry transient failures within a stated bound, and emit a copy-paste hand-off for the remainder, reporting partial
intent: a partial report + the hand-off block
fit_criterion: the permitted subset is applied; a 429 fixture retries then hands off; the hand-off completes the rest verbatim (SCAF-2 two-phase parity)
